text: Sorafenib is a multi-kinase inhibitor that functions as a potent antagonist of the KDR (VEGFR-2) receptor tyrosine kinase. By binding to the intracellular ATP-binding pocket of KDR, Sorafenib inhibits autophosphorylation and downstream signaling pathways, thereby suppressing the tumor angiogenesis essential for the progression of Renal Cell Carcinoma. This interaction is well-documented and serves as a primary mechanism for the drug's clinical efficacy in treating this malignancy.
